data.name: Frontier Mech: Ash Walkers
data.detailed_description:
Frontier Mech : Ash Walkers is a third-person mech shooter set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, combining fast-paced action with tactical tower defense elements. Control five unique mechs, fortify your defenses, gather resources, and craft powerful enhancements as you uncover a buried conspiracy.

Key Features:

  • TPS Combat Meets Tower Defense
    Engage in intense battles while strategically deploying and upgrading towers during key phases of each mission.

  • Five Playable Mechs
    Switch between Scout, Assault, Grenadier, Brawler, and Sniper mechs — each with unique mobility and weapon systems — to adapt to any battlefield situation.

  • Diverse Tower Arsenal
    Build and customize a variety of tower types: hit-scan turrets, AOE artillery, homing missile launchers, control towers, support structures, and resource extractors.

  • Modular Growth System
    Equip towers and mechs with powerful parts via a flexible slot system. Each part enhances attributes or unlocks new abilities based on its type and tier.

  • In-Battle & Out-of-Battle Resource Loops
    Earn alloy, blueprints, and materials by completing missions, defeating elite enemies, and managing resource points, allowing for continuous upgrade progression.

  • Immersive Single-Player Story Mode
    Follow Ash, a young mech technician and pilot, as he searches for his missing family. Encounter a mysterious girl marked by a forbidden experiment and uncover the truth behind a war-torn world of iron and ash.

data.short_description: Frontier Mech: Ash Walkers combines TPS combat with tower defense in a post-apocalyptic world. Pilot powerful mechs, build and upgrade defenses, and fend off insectoid invaders. Collect resources, enhance your mechs, and tackle challenging missions in this action-packed strategy game.
